title: Smartphones Are a Problem: Can They Be a Solution? (SOP65)

sentences.en: So at the 2018 APA convention, you gave a talk with a provocative title called Smartphones Are a Problem, Can They Be a Solution?
sentences.zh: 我们每天都听到关于智能手机如何影响我们的注意力、人际关系、方方面面，以及我们的整体健康。

sentences.zh: 嗯，凯特琳，你提出这个框架的方式，我认为正是我们思考这个问题的方式。

sentences.en: Well, Caitlin, the way that you frame that, I think, is exactly the way we think about it.
sentences.zh: 它们已经成了我们的救命稻草。

sentences.en: It's probably not too strong to say that we live on our phones or we live through our phones.
sentences.zh: 这里我不是在做价值判断，但不管怎样，这就是大多数人的生存现状，尤其是美国年轻人，

sentences.en: Not making a value judgment here, but that is, for better or worse, the state of play for most people, especially younger people in the U.S.

sentences.en: and increasingly around the world.
sentences.zh: 在行为健康领域，广义上讲，在过去的五十年里，我们大都在努力弄清楚如何衡量人们的状况。

sentences.en: In behavioral health, broadly, we've spent much of the last five decades trying to understand how to measure how people are doing.
sentences.zh: 我们通常的做法是问：你感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: And the way we usually do that is we say, how are you feeling?
sentences.zh: 希望他们能给我们一个回答，帮助我们评估他们过去几天、几周或几个月的运作水平。

sentences.en: In the hopes that we will get from them a reply that will help us to assess their level of functioning over the previous days, weeks, or months.
sentences.zh: 这是我们第一次能够通过使用那个作为他们生命线的设备，也就是他们赖以生存的方式，来直接观察他们的运作状态。

sentences.en: For the first time, we actually have a way of looking directly at how they're functioning by using the device that is their lifeline, that is the way in which they're living.

sentences.en: We can actually look every day over the previous two weeks and know exactly how they're doing in terms of how they're managing the world around them.

sentences.zh: 可以使用智能手机设备，使用这些工具，不再需要你每隔一天或每周

sentences.zh: 我们已经远远超越了这些法规，以确保我们收集的数据不仅经过加密，而且受到双重保护。

sentences.en: We've gone way beyond those to make sure that the data that we collect is not only encrypted, but it's doubly protected.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，它的设置方式是：如果有人对他们数据发生的事情感到不安，他们拥有完全的自主权和充分的机会来选择退出。

sentences.en: And most of all, it's set up in such a way that if someone is uncomfortable with what's happening with their data, they have full agency, full opportunity to be able to withdraw.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切都是为了建立这样一个系统：它不仅

sentences.en: So this is all about building a system that's not only
sentences.zh: 在临床价值方面是有效的，而且还能赢得公众的信任，因为它提供了透明度，

sentences.en: effective in terms of its clinical value, but it earns public trust because it provides transparency,
sentences.zh: 关注隐私和安全，最重要的是，它赋予了被收集数据的人以自主权。

sentences.en: it cares about privacy and security, and most of all, it confers agency to the people whose data you're collecting.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这些结合在一起可以帮助我们。

sentences.en: Those together, I think, can help us.
sentences.zh: 我们在MindStrong确立的北极星原则是：通过向患者和家属提供更好的数据来赋予他们力量。

sentences.en: What we've said is our North Star at MindStrong is the idea that we're empowering patients and families by giving them better data.
sentences.zh: 我认为，如果我们把这作为北极星原则，作为我们想要打造一款真正通过提供我们能给出的最好数据来帮助人们的产品的方式，

sentences.en: And I think if we keep that as the North Star, as the way that we want to build a product that really helps people
sentences.zh: 我认为这对于建立公众信任

sentences.en: by giving them the best data we can give them, I think that actually goes a long way to building public
sentences.zh: 会大有帮助。那么，你能谈谈像这样的应用程序如何改善医疗保健、心理健康护理，以及整体的医疗保健吗？

sentences.en: truSt. And so can you talk about how apps like this improve health care, mental health care, and then health care overall?
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一个有趣的时刻。

sentences.en: You know, it's an interesting point in time.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们仍处于一个非常令人兴奋的故事的早期阶段。

sentences.en: I think we're still early on in what will be, I think, a very exciting story.
sentences.zh: 我们可能正处于第一章或第二章，许多应用程序和公司已经展示了它们的可行性以及它们所能创造的信号的威力，

sentences.en: We may be in chapter one or chapter two, where many apps and many companies have shown the feasibility and shown the power of the signals they can
sentences.zh: 或者它们通过智能手机提供干预措施的价值。

sentences.en: create or the value of the interventions they can deliver through the smartphone.
sentences.zh: 我们在现阶段还不知道这项新技术对公共健康的影响会是什么。

sentences.en: What we don't know at this point is what the impact of this new technology will be on public health.
sentences.zh: 我们尚未将其部署给数百万或数千万有需要的民众，从而无法断言：嘿，这减少了自杀。

sentences.en: We haven't yet had the deployment to millions or multi-millions of people in need to be able to say, hey, this decreases suicide.
sentences.zh: 这减少了住院率和急诊室就诊次数。

sentences.en: This reduces hospitalization and emergency room visits.
sentences.zh: 这降低了成本，同时提高了护理质量，并给我们带来了更好的结果。

sentences.en: This reduces the cost while improving the quality of care and giving us better outcomes.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都想要这个。

sentences.en: All of us want that.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都在朝着这个方向努力。

sentences.en: All of us are on that path.
sentences.zh: 但我想说，在2018年8月初的当下，我们还没有走到那一步。

sentences.en: But I'd say here at the beginning of August 2018, we're not there yet.
sentences.zh: 所以我想你刚才已经回答了我的最后一个问题。

sentences.en: And so I believe you probably just answered my last question.
sentences.zh: 我再确认一下。

sentences.en: I'll just double check.
sentences.zh: 这是医疗保健的未来吗？

sentences.en: Is this the future of health care?
sentences.zh: 如果是的话，有什么局限性？

sentences.en: And if so, what are the limitations?
sentences.zh: 有哪些好处？

sentences.en: What are the benefits?
sentences.zh: 有哪些局限性？

sentences.en: What are the limitations?
sentences.zh: 对，所以我们正处于一个多么有趣的时代啊。

sentences.en: Yeah, so what an interesting time we're in.
sentences.zh: 对，所以我们正处于一个多么有趣的时代啊。

sentences.en: I think it's fair to say that health care will be changing.
sentences.zh: 我认为可以公平地说，医疗保健将会发生变化。

sentences.en: And in some ways, we're slow to this change.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，我们对这种变化的反应比较迟缓。

sentences.en: And retail and entertainment and banking and so much of our society has already been transformed by this digital and information revolution.
sentences.zh: 而零售、娱乐、银行以及我们社会的许多领域，已经经由这场数字和信息革命发生了变革。

sentences.en: It hasn't happened for health care.
sentences.zh: 医疗保健领域却没有发生这种情况。

sentences.en: And maybe that's not surprising.
sentences.zh: 或许这并不令人意外。

sentences.en: And maybe we should have expected that health care would be a little slow to the party.
sentences.zh: 也许我们早就该料到，医疗保健在这场变革中会显得有点后知后觉。

sentences.en: The fact that Amazon and Berkshire Hathaway and JP Morgan and now come together to say, hey, we want to look at health care and we want to try to provide something that gets
sentences.zh: 亚马逊、伯克希尔·哈撒韦和摩根大通如今联合起来宣布，嘿，我们想要关注医疗保健，我们想尝试提供

sentences.en: better outcomes at lower costs and is more acceptable to our employees.
sentences.zh: 以更低的成本带来更好的治疗效果，并且让我们的员工更能接受的服务。

sentences.en: That's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣。

sentences.en: And I think we'll see over the next couple of years that those companies and many others are going to begin to transform the way health care gets delivered.
sentences.zh: 我想在接下来的几年里，我们会看到这些公司以及许多其他公司开始改变医疗服务的提供方式。

sentences.en: My guess is at the end of the day, we're not talking about a completely online system, not only because we need to have surgical centers, we need ICUs, we need to have hospitals
sentences.zh: 我的猜测是，到头来我们讨论的并不是一个完全线上的系统，不仅因为我们需要手术中心，需要重症监护室，需要医院

sentences.en: where people can get intensive care.
sentences.zh: 让人们能够获得重症监护。

sentences.en: But even for mental health care, it's likely that we will have both online and offline.
sentences.zh: 而且即使对于心理健康护理，我们也很有可能会同时拥有线上和线下两种方式。

sentences.en: And I think the future of mental health care is going to be both high-tech and high-touch.
sentences.zh: 我认为未来心理健康护理的发展方向将是高科技与高接触相结合。

sentences.en: How we put those together and how we build both the high-tech and a better high-touch system is going to be really interesting.
sentences.zh: 我们如何将这两者结合起来，如何构建既有高科技又有更好高接触的系统，将会非常有趣。

sentences.en: And we're going to see that over the next four or five years.
sentences.zh: 我们将在未来四五年内见证这一点。

sentences.en: MindStrong is one of many companies pushing on this high-tech side.
sentences.zh: MindStrong 就是众多推动这一高科技方向发展的公司之一。

sentences.en: But we recognize as well that tech is only going to go so far.
sentences.zh: 但我们也认识到，科技的作用终究是有限的。

sentences.en: And that when you're dealing with people with serious mental illness, you've got to have the high-touch piece as well.
sentences.zh: 当你在处理患有严重精神疾病的人群时，你也必须具备高接触的关怀部分。

sentences.en: What we're banking on is that we can use the tech to get much better high-touch.
sentences.zh: 我们所依靠的是，我们可以利用科技来实现更好的高接触服务。

sentences.en: And that, I think, will be the future of the mental health care system in the way that we're going to build it.
sentences.zh: 我想，这将是未来构建心理健康护理系统的方式。

sentences.en: So I do have one more question.
sentences.zh: 所以，我还有一个问题。

sentences.en: I had one more.
sentences.zh: 我还有一个。

sentences.en: I know I said it was my laSt. So where is MindStrong at this point?
sentences.zh: 我知道我刚才说过那是最后一个。那么，MindStrong 目前发展到什么阶段了？

sentences.en: Where are you right now?
sentences.zh: 你们现在在哪里？

sentences.en: And is it available for people?
sentences.zh: 人们可以使用它吗？

sentences.en: Where are you?
sentences.zh: 你们在哪？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So MindStrong is a work in progress.
sentences.zh: 所以，MindStrong 还在开发完善中。

sentences.en: It's a company that's a little over a year old, year and a half old, although it has about four or five years of data behind it.
sentences.zh: 这家公司成立刚满一年或一年半左右，不过它的背后有大约四五年的数据支持。

sentences.en: We are building the company through partnerships with mostly, at this point, health care providers and payers.
sentences.zh: 我们目前主要通过与医疗保健提供者和支付方的合作来建立这家公司。

sentences.en: So our interest is in creating a new health care company for mental health that will use technology.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们的兴趣在于创建一家利用技术的全新心理健康医疗公司。

sentences.en: We don't provide a consumer device or a consumer app.
sentences.zh: 我们不提供消费级设备或消费级应用程序。

sentences.en: Though the app is on the Play Store and it's on the App Store, it's not really set up for downloading for individuals to use for themselves.
sentences.zh: 尽管这个应用程序在 Play 商店和 App Store 上线了，但它并不是真正为个人下载使用而设置的。

sentences.en: We want to use this within a health care setting.
sentences.zh: 我们希望在医疗保健环境中使用它。

sentences.en: And so it's available through the research we're currently doing and the partnerships
sentences.zh: 所以它可以通过我们目前正在进行的研究所获得，并且通过

sentences.en: we currently have with a range of both academics for research and the partners that are payers and providers for actually testing out what this does in health care.
sentences.zh: 我们目前与各种学术机构（用于研究）以及作为支付方和提供者的合作伙伴建立的合作关系，来实际测试它在医疗保健中的作用。

sentences.en: It sounds like there's some exciting times ahead.
sentences.zh: 听起来未来有很多令人兴奋的时刻。

sentences.en: Super exciting.
sentences.zh: 超级令人兴奋。

sentences.en: And you know, I think for a lot of members of the APA, particularly for students who are thinking like, what's my future all about?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我认为对于许多 APA 成员，特别是那些在思考“我的未来究竟会怎样”的学生来说，

sentences.en: It's important to recognize that this is a moment in time where the sands are shifting in the same way that a decade ago that would have been
sentences.zh: 认识到这是一个格局正在发生巨变的时代非常重要，正如十年前

sentences.en: true for retail, for entertainment, for many aspects of our economy.
sentences.zh: 零售、娱乐以及我们经济的许多其他领域所经历的那样。

sentences.en: That's happening now in health care and in mental health care.
sentences.zh: 这种变革现在正发生在医疗保健和心理健康护理领域。

sentences.en: You know, Bill Gates famously said that things will change much less than we expect in the next two years and much more than we expect in the next 10.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，比尔·盖茨曾有一句名言：人们总是高估未来两年的变化，而低估未来十年的变化。

sentences.en: And I think that's true for mental health care and technology as well.
sentences.zh: 我认为这对心理健康护理和技术来说同样适用。

sentences.en: Well, thank you so much for joining us today.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您今天加入我们。

sentences.en: Thank you, Kaitlin.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，凯特琳。
